description: Fluoroquinolone antibiotic: intense primary π→π* absorption at 277 nm (ε ~25000 in 0.1M HCl) from the 4-quinolone-3-carboxylic acid chromophore, with a double-shoulder at 315 nm and 329 nm from vibronic fine structure of the β-band.
clinicalNote: Broad-spectrum fluoroquinolone antibiotic. Pharmacopoeial UV assay in 0.1M HCl at 277 nm (ε ~25000). Amphoteric: pKa₁ 6.1 (COOH) and pKa₂ 8.7 (piperazine NH).

sources.citation: British Pharmacopoeia 2023, Ciprofloxacin Hydrochloride Monograph. UV assay at 277 nm in 0.1M HCl; ε 25000 L·mol⁻¹·cm⁻¹.

sources.purpose: Spectrophotometric assay conditions and extinction coefficients in 0.1M HCl
